seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Stanton, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Stanton, California for 2026: the City Hall tree lighting plus four Stanton Library holiday craft and carol programs.
lede: Stanton lights its tree at City Hall on December 3, then fills the next two weeks with holiday crafts and carols at the Stanton Library.
celebrates: Stanton keeps its Christmas close to Katella Avenue. The City of Stanton holds an annual Christmas Tree Lighting at City Hall, 7800 Katella Ave, and for 2026 the theme is Holidays Around the World, with a special choral performance, cookie decorating and a visit from Santa. Four family programs follow at the Stanton Library, 7850 Katella Ave, run by OC Public Libraries: Holiday Card Making, Mini Canvas Ornaments, a Hot Cocoa and Snowball Bash, and Carolers and Crafts. Together they cover December 3 to December 15 with something for most ages.
lastyear: The City of Stanton's website announced its tree lighting for Thursday, December 4, 2025, at 6:30 pm at City Hall. The city also posted that Stanton Central Park would close early that day in anticipation of the event, and it told residents City Hall would reopen on Monday, December 1 with regular hours. The 2026 ceremony keeps the same City Hall setting and 6:30 pm start but moves to Thursday, December 3, and adds the Holidays Around the World theme with a choral performance.
facts: Stanton City Hall and the Stanton Library sit on the same stretch of Katella Avenue, at 7800 and 7850 Katella Ave, so families can pair the December 3 tree lighting with a library program in the same part of town. The city calls its tree lighting annual, and its news page says the ceremony goes ahead rain or shine. The library's four holiday programs all fall in the first half of December.
trains: Stanton has no Christmas train event of its own in 2026. The nearest listed train rides are at the City of Cypress Holiday Sing and Tree Lighting on Tuesday, December 1, where the city lists train rides beside Santa and Mrs. Claus on the Civic Center Green. For a longer day out, our Anaheim guide covers Holidays at the Disneyland Resort.

faq: When is the Stanton tree lighting in 2026?
Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 6:30 pm at Stanton City Hall, 7800 Katella Ave, according to the City of Stanton.

The city lists a special choral performance, cookie decorating and a visit from Santa, with a Holidays Around the World theme.

Yes. The city says the tree lighting goes ahead rain or shine.
Where are the Stanton Library holiday programs?
At the Stanton Library, 7850 Katella Ave, Stanton, CA 90680, on December 5, 10, 12 and 15.
